title: Not the softest sheets and very wrinkly right out of the dryer
text: Not the softest sheets and very wrinkly right out of the dryer. Well, I will give these a try...  I have washed 4 times now, still stiff sheets, very wrinkly right out of the dryer and very noisy when you turn over in bed.  Just weird.  I tried them to see if the pet hair would stay off these sheets better, but that didn't happen either.  I will be going back to my regular PURPLE bamboo sheets which are amazing, despite the pet hair that clings to them at times.
